# Azure Velour

Azure Velour is the *fandom name* for a lilac-coated Earth-pony mare with an aqua ponytail threaded through a white-and-dark baseball cap. She is the blue-haired dancer on the **right** of DJ Pon-3’s trio at Manehattan’s Club Pony Party Palace, alongside red-haired Flashdancer and mint-green Pacific Glow (also called *Molly* by fans). Her black-and-white streetwear, pale leg warmers, and cap make her easy to spot. Her cutie mark is not clearly established. See the [G4 Earth-pony catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies).

**Names and voice.** *Azure Velour* was in fan use by 2016; it is not confirmed as a spoken or credited television name. Gameloft uses **Hyped-Up Dancer** for her in its [Dancin’ Fools collection](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Collections). Enterplay depicts the club dancers on [*Ravers, Glowsticks Optional*](https://www.ccgcastle.com/product/my-little-pony/defenders-of-equestria/ravers-glowsticks-optional), a group card rather than an individual name. Her verified television appearance is **“The Saddle Row Review” (S6E9; 2016)**. She has no verified spoken line or credited voice actor.

## Important moments

1. **A neon-lit dance routine — “The Saddle Row Review” (S6E9).** Azure dances with Flashdancer and Pacific Glow in DJ Pon-3’s upstairs club, creating the noise problem above Rarity’s new boutique. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YHp6wHBGUjk) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **The dancers’ disappointed reaction — “The Saddle Row Review” (S6E9).** When Pinkie Pie must address the loud music, Azure’s displeased expression makes this otherwise wordless background character memorable. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Saddle_Row_Review) — scene timestamp unavailable.

These are visual beats, not separate speaking roles or plot-changing decisions.
